name: A Cruel Demon's Fate
source:
The King is Dead and you're the only one who can commune with the Cosmos to name the rightful heir to the throne.

In A Cruel Demon's Fate, you play as the Oracle, a human living in Asca'ath—the dimension of Demons—in the city of D'Mensi, and the king has just died of unknown causes. You're now undertaking the biggest task you've ever been handed as the sole person who can speak to the Cosmos: naming the new king.

[From [url=https://nnanapop.itch.io/a-cruel-demons-fate]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
国王死了，你是唯一一个能够与宇宙交流并指定王位合法继承人的人。

在《残酷恶魔的命运》中，你扮演神谕者，一个生活在阿斯卡阿斯（恶魔的维度）达门西市的人类，而国王刚刚死于不明原因。作为唯一可以与宇宙对话的人，你现在正在承担有史以来最艰巨的任务：任命新国王。

[来自[url=https://nnanapop.itch.io/a-cruel-demons-fate]Itch.io[/url]]
